# BizGrow Tech

## About
BizGrow Tech provides comprehensive monthly IT Support and Outsourcing services for SMEs, clinics, offices, and factories. We specialize in reducing downtime, protecting data, and solving IT issues without the need for a full-time in-house IT department.

## Services
- Monthly IT Support (Remote & On-site)
- Server & Network Management
- Cloud Services Management (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Azure)
- Preventive Maintenance
- Website and E-commerce management

## Pricing & Packages
1. Starter Package: 3,500 THB/month. Includes unlimited remote support, server monitoring, for up to 15 devices.
2. Basic Package: 5,500 THB/month. Includes unlimited remote support, 1 on-site visit per month, for up to 30 devices.
3. Pro Package: 9,500 THB/month. Includes unlimited remote support, 2 on-site visits per month, priority support, for up to 50 devices.

## Target Audience
Suitable for any organization size (from 1 to 100+ devices) that needs reliable IT infrastructure without hiring full-time IT staff.
